issues.description: The type of the Bitmap24::data member is inconsistent between the template and solution (and between the template header and template implementation). In template/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp the field is declared as 'int *data', but the implementation in example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp (template) allocates and treats it as 'char *' (new char[...] and byte-wise accesses). The solution's Bitmap24.hpp declares 'char *data'. This mismatch will cause compilation type-errors and confusion mapping the header to the implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp consistent with the implementation and solution by changing the data member to 'char *data'. Alternatively, change all uses in the .cpp to use 'int *' consistently, but the intended and working type is 'char *' for byte-wise bitmap storage.
